response.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE player_id IN (SELECT DISTINCT player_id FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS') GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples IS NOT NULL DESC, total_triples DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: "Total triples across all of their postseason batting records" refers to all postseason records, not only NL World Series records. The condition filters which players to include, but the sum spans all their postseason games.

alternatives.interpretation: If "all of their postseason batting records" was intended to mean only records matching the filter (league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS'), sum only those records instead.
alternatives.sql: SELECT player_id, SUM(triple) AS total_triples FROM batting_postseason WHERE league_id = 'NL' AND round = 'WS' GROUP BY player_id ORDER BY total_triples IS NOT NULL DESC, total_triples DESC LIMIT 10;
